AnnotationCueType.description:
Tier-2 lightweight annotation cue types (schemas/proposition.py::PropositionAnnotation).
Candidate cues only -- never a guaranteed semantic interpretation. See "RISK
ANALYSIS" in docs/efficiency-and-processing-architecture.md: these back
`research_hypothesis`/`experimental_review_cue` labels only, never a proof of error.
AnnotationCueType.title: AnnotationCueType

of model error. See "RISK ANALYSIS",
docs/efficiency-and-processing-architecture.md.
CueEpistemicLabel.title: CueEpistemicLabel

description:
A Tier-2 lightweight annotation: a candidate risk cue or dependency link, never a
guaranteed semantic interpretation (docs/efficiency-and-processing-architecture.md
§1). `epistemic_label` is always `research_hypothesis` or `experimental_review_cue`
-- this type structurally cannot assert a confirmed error, matching the registry's
own epistemic-status discipline for the mechanisms these cues might feed into.
title: PropositionAnnotation
